notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Remastered Audio With FMOD
We recently decided to switch to FMOD for our audio. This redefines the audio experience in the game. There were a lot of sound issues that we wanted to address with so many audio events being played, and the existing solution was not manageable. FMOD allows us to push the audio quite a bit further, and we have a lot of new ideas planned to take advantage of this in the future. Let us know what you think. 

  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/5600c7df335a23903b84aa4845daee7f149d1554.png"]

Visual FX Improvements
We have been implementing some new animation and FX for specific card selections. We wanted to place more importance of the cards and there abilities. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/9e15adf7f69e9a792050fcaef607f3e7d3f53d1a.png"]Acquiring an Aspect Card from the Room Hand

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/8ec396e905810a200c5f132cce9e7df6f4df5f4b.png"]Acquiring a Healing Card from the Room Hand

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/271997431e9d7a88859b0bb3d4f99ec9c4cacd17.png"]Using an Aspect Card from the Aspect Cards in Hand


Minor Fixes
On top of everything else we have been actively testing and fixing a lot of minor issues. If you happen to encounter anything during your play-time, please let us know in the Discussion boards.
